title: 137 · The bug that refuses to be fixed
provenance: Independent pure-time vector/Canvas reconstruction of the complete 90-second animated bug short. Night coding room, monitor camera, irregular colored code bands, expressive glowing bug and wings, arrow/hand/crosshair/caret actions, warning underline, marquee/blue/red selection, particle deletion, hide/escape/death-and-return beats, room pullback and final title. No source video, full-frame raster sequences or reference images loaded. Original soundtrack is attributed comparison-only, not authored.

scenes.name: Dark room fades in
Developer codes at night under moon window
Camera pushes through monitor
Colored code bands and sleeping bug
Macro camera approaches firefly
Bug wakes, eyes and wings unfold
Bug settles within the code line
Red diagnostic underline catches bug
White cursor enters from upper right
Cursor approaches diagnostic
Cursor looms in macro view
Bug hides in dim code and peeks around cursor
Bug returns to red diagnostic line
Bug flees arrow; cursor turns into crosshair
Moving selection marquee chases bug
Code region becomes blue selection
Selected code bursts into square fragments
Bug flies around crosshair and arrow
Camera and code scroll during chase
Cursor looms beside bug in close-up
Bug disguises itself as a thin caret
Camera pulls back; caret disguise hides behind arrow
Arrow searches caret; bug emerges near its point
Arrow changes into pointing hand and selects row
Blue selected row turns red
Hand has left; bug droops on red selected line
Red line erases from right as square debris falls
Last small red line segment
Wide cut briefly shows hand, then busy arrow
Macro bug droops and eyes close
Bug brightens and raises antennae
Arrow waits near fallen red fragments
Red code row extends again
Red row becomes blue and bug springs free
New red diagnostic follows the bug
Macro code typing above bug and diagnostic
Bug reacts and hops with moving caret
Arrow points to bug; bug remains
Macro bug and glowing caret settle
Background dims, caret and bug keep pulsing
Camera returns through screen to relaxed developer
Room fades to dark
WON’T FIX title hold
